title: Catching the search race with breakpoints
purpose: Use a line breakpoint, a conditional breakpoint, a logpoint and the ignore list on line 6 of the search code, and read the async call stack at the pause.
sequence_reason: Each step depends on the one before: the line breakpoint shows two pauses, the condition keeps only the stale one, the Call Stack explains it, and the ignore list cleans the stack.
summary: Line 6 calls render(items) after await search(q). A line breakpoint there pauses twice: first with q react, then with q re, which leaves the wrong list. A conditional breakpoint with q !== input.value pauses only on the stale re response. At that pause the Call Stack shows onInput line 6, an await separator, and onInput line 5 with two vendor frames below. A logpoint prints the same values in the Console without pausing. Adding vendor/events.js to the ignore list hides the two vendor frames.
explanation: The async part of the Call Stack, below the await separator, shows the call that started the wait. Its Scope still holds the old q, so you see that a stale response reached render.

learning_check.question: At the conditional pause, q is re and input.value is react. What does that tell you?
learning_check.answer: This response belongs to an older request. render is about to replace the newer react results with stale re results.

scenes.heading: Line 6 calls render(items)
scenes.narration: Line 5 waits for search(q). Line 6 calls render(items). We set breakpoints on line 6.

scenes.heading: A line breakpoint pauses twice
scenes.narration: A line breakpoint on line 6 pauses twice. Pause 1: q is react. Pause 2: q is re, so the list shows re results.

scenes.heading: A conditional breakpoint pauses only on the stale response
scenes.narration: Now add a condition to line 6: q !== input.value. Condition false means no pause. Condition true pauses on the stale re response.

scenes.heading: Read the async call stack
scenes.narration: The Call Stack shows onInput app.js:6, then await, then onInput app.js:5. The frames below await show the call that started the wait.

scenes.heading: A logpoint watches without pausing
scenes.narration: A logpoint on line 6 prints q and input.value. The Console shows render react react, then render re react. The page never pauses.

scenes.heading: The ignore list hides library frames
scenes.narration: Add vendor/events.js to the ignore list. Ignore list off: five frames. Ignore list on: only your own frames stay in the Call Stack.

visual.verdict: Library frames are hidden; your frames stay.
